messages:
maya: Nightly SBOM/vuln scan found libcurl CVE-2026-0458 in runtime base (alpine:3.18). Need patch.
sam: Scan: https://scans.internal/291234 1 show exploit path via HTTP/2, severity=high for edge-facing services.
ops-jen: Note: KMS RBAC tightening went out last night; could break image signing. @infra-oncall can you confirm?
infra-oncall: Confirmed we removed signing permission from a couple pipeline SAs as least-privilege.
sam: If signing fails CI, images won't promote. Compliance prefers signed builds. Propose temporary, time-bound grant.
sec-bot: Log: signing failure at 2026-06-10T03:12Z for serviceAccount:image-pipeline@redwood 1 PermissionDenied cloudkms.cryptoKeyVersions.useToSign
ops-jen: Plan: 1) Add conditional signing grant (expires T+3h) 2) Trigger base-image build with libcurl patch 3) Run SBOM+scan 4) Canary rollout 5) Revoke grant and record audit.
maya: Starting build: `ci/base-image/refresh --patch=libcurl-7.88.1 --ticket=INC-4521`
sec-bot: Build job=ci-base-9987 started; logs -> https://ci.internal/jobs/ci-base-9987
infra-oncall: I'll watch KMS audit and confirm sign event.
maya: Build SUCCESS, vuln gone, SBOM updated. Pushing canary.
sec-bot: Canary 30m: no regressions, error rate stable.
ops-jen: Revoking temporary IAM grant now and recording change as `temporary-grant:image-pipeline:INC-4521`.
sam: Revoked and logged. Added iam-change tag to ticket.
compliance: Received SBOM diff and KMS audit links; evidence attached to INC-4521. Keep postmortem short note about RBAC window.
maya: Canary promoted to 100%. Closing loop.
